description: How far a TextDiffResult had to degrade to stay within the configured limits. A pathological input never throws — the comparison is coarsened instead and reports that it was, so a consumer can tell the reader the diff is approximate.

members.name: None
members.description: The comparison ran at the requested granularity and within the limits.

members.name: LineLevel
members.description: A word-level comparison exceeded MaxTokens or MaxCells, so the result describes whole lines instead.

members.name: SingleChange
members.description: Even the line-level comparison exceeded the limits, so the result is a single change over the whole input (or a single Equal hunk when the inputs match).
